Author: Kotanna
Name: CatProof
Punchline: Locks the keyboard in FFXIV so cats can't type or press hotkeys while you play on a controller.
Description: While locked, FFXIV, Dalamud and plugin windows ignore key presses from physical keyboards: no typing in chat, no movement, no hotkeys. Controller, mouse and keys sent by software (Steam Input, Job Profiles) keep working. /catproof toggles the lock, also from a macro or Flick Wheel; /catproof on, /catproof off, /catproof config. A small movable indicator with an Unlock button shows while locked.
